title: Correct human-only mapping evidence types in agent-authored campaign proposals
body:
Confirmed proposal provenance defect: new agent-authored `ontology_mapping.evidence` entries use `EvidenceTypeEnum.MANUAL_CURATION`, whose maintained schema definition specifically says evidence supplied by a human reviewer. LLM-assisted history does not make that human-source assertion true. No schema or gate change is needed.

Worker08 independent finding **W08-IR-001**, reviewed head `b90a2fd4681d20e2586481b7b9b1114a78281b94`, identifies 95 new/changed entries across 88 selected payloads. Its full review, exact field/value reproductions and authorship receipts are under `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/workers/w03/worktree/.temp/w08-published-head-independent-review-v1/`; findings SHA256 `11e3681d90be88d52a309fc6ed301bcb4c37c749ffb144640175cea6db501af5`. A first unpublished coordinator reconciliation successor independently reproduces the same defect in newly authored mapping evidence. Its original bytes are retained; its attempted separate correction was interrupted before any candidate content was written, and will proceed only after this issue is recorded.

A campaign-wide mechanical scan of the frozen 981-proposal intake flags 698 new entries in 646 proposals across nine worker slots. Those are **audit leads**, not 698 independently confirmed false claims. Worker02 is independently classifying exact before/after entries and actual author/source provenance; current successor changes must be reconciled before final counts. Historical human-supplied evidence must survive.

Required correction: use the honest source/decision type justified for each new entry (for example LLM_SUGGESTION for agent interpretation, or a direct database/cross-reference type only where its actual evidence warrants it). Preserve exact source URLs, raw values, prior history and all scientific decisions/holds. Apply through guarded writers, retain first attempts, add meaningful regression checks and independently review changed final bytes. Do not transfer inherited owner approval to a changed hash.

Do not perform a global token replacement: `ComponentEvidenceTypeEnum.MANUAL_CURATION` has a different definition; mapping quality, historical manual reviews and genuine human-supplied evidence require separate interpretation. This is a proposal/candidate correction, not a claim that current canonical mappings fail QC.

Deduplication read current all-state searches and full #966/#967/#1217 bodies/comments. #966/#967 concern rendered disclosure and its tests; #1217 concerns a worker06 component/provenance batch. None tracks this cross-campaign new MappingEvidence defect. Relate W08-IR-001 here and keep its other findings separate. No person mentions, release approval or merge.
